title: mutastic.yaml, v1
description: A project's own say over which mutants run, in the nearest `mutastic.yaml` at or above a module's directory. mutastic reads it strictly: a key it doesn't know is an error, so this schema refuses one too. See https://docs.mutastic.io/guides/configuration/.

extends.description: Another `mutastic.yaml` whose rules, plugins and filters this file adds to, by its path from this file's directory. Its operators apply only when this file chooses none.

rules.description: Code to skip, or to mutate though mutastic would skip it as arid, each with its reason.

plugins.description: Plugins, by their path from the project's directory: a jar of filters and operators, or a rules file (`.yaml` or `.yml`) of call operators.

filters.description: The plugin filters to run, by id: a plugin's filter runs only when it's named here.

operators.description: Which operators run, as `--operators` chooses, which replaces this for one run: a set (`defaults`, `stronger`, `extended`, `all`), an operator's namespace or id, or one of those after `-` to leave it out.

pattern.description: A class or method: `**` matches any depth, `*` one name, and `Class#method` one method.

reason.description: Why: shown with each mutant the rule skips.

skip.description: Skip the mutants in this code. A skipped mutant stays out of the score.

mutate.description: Mutate what mutastic would skip in this code as arid, such as a `toString()` that's a contract. Never brings back generated or equivalent code.
